specName: Find the Spec Kit project in a multi-root workspace
last_action: all 14 tasks done, full suite passes

FR-001.title: One project folder used by every surface

FR-002.title: Detection order: config folder, then specs directory, then first folder

FR-003.title: A single-folder workspace behaves as before

FR-006.title: An ambiguous pick is reported in the output channel

expectations: No living specs colocated in a second workspace folder
No several Spec Kit projects in one window at once
context: area: apps/vscode/src/features/specs and apps/vscode/src/features/spec-viewer (sidebar, commands, viewer handlers)
area: apps/vscode/src/features/steering, living-specs, workflows, spec-editor, pipeline-builder, skills, agents
area: apps/vscode/src/ai-providers and apps/vscode/src/speckit (terminal cwd, detection, install)
constraint: a resource-scoped setting is read with a resource and a per-folder root never comes from workspaceFolders[0]
constraint: an inline config default must match the package.json manifest default
constraint: a probe must distinguish no from could-not-tell
intent: Resolve one Spec Kit project folder in a multi-root workspace, by detection or a setting, and use it everywhere

decisions.decision: One uncached resolver in core, getProjectRoot
decisions.why: Tests reassign workspace folders with no event and specify init creates the marker silently
decisions.rejected: A cache cleared by the watcher

decisions.decision: Marker is .specify or the speckit agent files, shared with the detector
decisions.why: Two probes would let the sidebar and the welcome view disagree
decisions.rejected: Probing every configured spec directory pattern

decisions.decision: speckit.projectFolder is window scoped and read with no resource
decisions.why: The choice is per window and a resource read would be circular
They only trigger refreshes and have no teardown plumbing

decisions.decision: workflowSelector and pipelineResolution keep the spec owner folder first
decisions.why: Pinned by tests and correct for a spec opened from another folder

decisions.decision: Probe with statSync and treat only not-found as absent
decisions.why: An unreadable folder must not read as an empty one

decisions.decision: Checkpoint git and PR commands run in the project root
decisions.why: They used the first folder as cwd, which is the same assumption being removed

plan.summary: One core resolver, a window setting, a change event, and a mechanical swap across 36 files
plan.key_finding: Roots cached at start-up (ConfigManager, AgentManager, SkillManager, steering watchers) are what break on a change, not the inline reads

tasks.summary: 14 tasks: Foundational (7, four area swaps in parallel), US1 (2), US2 (2), US3 (1), Polish (2)

implement.summary: One project-folder resolver with a setting and change event, used by every surface

approach: A core resolver picks the project folder from the speckit.projectFolder setting or by detection, with no cache and no disk read for a one-folder workspace. Every inline first-folder read swaps to it, cached roots become getters, and one change event refreshes views, detection and root-bound watchers.
